units.source_text: 薰大将到了比叡山上，按照每月例规供养经佛。

en.t: General Kaoru went up to Mount Hiei and, according to the monthly custom, made offerings to the scriptures and Buddhas.

units.source_text: 次日来到横山，僧都看见贵人驾临，甚是惊惶。

en.t: The next day he came to Yokawa, and when the Sozu saw such a noble visitor arrive, he was greatly startled and flustered.

units.source_text: 以前薰大将为了举办祈祷等事，早年就和这僧都相识，但并不特别亲热。

en.t: Earlier, General Kaoru had become acquainted with this Sozu through matters such as arranging prayers, but they had not been especially close.

units.source_text: 此次一品公主患病，僧都替她举办祈祷，效验非常显著，

en.t: This time, when Princess Ippon fell ill, the Sozu performed prayers for her, and their efficacy was remarkably clear,

units.source_text: 薰大将亲眼目睹之后，便十分尊敬他，对他的信任比以前更深了。

en.t: After General Kaoru witnessed this with his own eyes, he came to respect him greatly and trusted him even more deeply than before.

units.source_text: 薰大将那样身价重大的贵人特地来访，

en.t: Since a noble of General Kaoru's great rank had come specially to visit,

units.source_text: 僧都当然奔走忙碌，竭诚招待。

en.t: the Sozu naturally hurried about busily and received him with all sincerity.

units.source_text: 两人细细地谈了一会佛法之后，僧都请薰大将吃些泡饭。

en.t: After the two had talked in detail for a while about the Buddhist law, the Sozu invited General Kaoru to have some rice soaked in hot water.

units.source_text: 到了四周人声渐静之时，薰大将问道：“你在小野那边有熟识的人家么？”

en.t: When the voices of the people around them had gradually grown quiet, General Kaoru asked, "Do you have any household you know well over in Ono?"

units.source_text: 僧都答道：“有的，但那地方非常鄙陋。

en.t: The Sozu answered, "I do, but that place is very humble and shabby.

units.source_text: 贫僧的母亲是个老朽的尼僧，

en.t: My mother is an aged nun,

units.source_text: 因为京中没有适当的住处，贫僧又常闭居在这山中，

en.t: and because there is no suitable place for her to live in the capital, while I myself am often shut away here in the mountains,

units.source_text: 所以叫她住在这里附近的小野地方，便于朝夕前往探望。”

en.t: I have had her live nearby in Ono, so that I can go morning and evening to visit and look after her."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“那地方以前很热闹，现在衰落了。”

en.t: General Kaoru said, "That place used to be very lively, but now it has declined."

units.source_text: 然后向僧都靠近些，低声说道：“有一件事，

en.t: Then he moved a little closer to the Sozu and said in a low voice, "There is something

units.source_text: 我也不甚确悉，想要问你，又恐你茫然不知何事，

en.t: that I myself do not know very clearly. I want to ask you about it, but I fear you may be at a loss and not know what I mean,

units.source_text: 因此多方顾虑，不曾启口。

en.t: so I have hesitated in many ways and have not opened my mouth about it until now.

units.source_text: 不瞒你说：我有一个心爱的女子，听说隐藏在小野山乡中。

en.t: To tell you the truth, there is a woman dear to my heart, and I have heard that she is hidden away in the mountain village of Ono.

units.source_text: 如果确是如此，我颇思探寻她的近况如何。

en.t: If that is truly so, I very much wish to find out how she is doing now.

units.source_text: 最近忽然闻得：她已当了你的弟子，你已给她落发受戒了，不知是否事实？

en.t: Recently I suddenly heard that she has become your disciple and that you have cut her hair and given her the precepts. I do not know whether this is true.

units.source_text: 此女年纪还轻，家里现有父母等人，

en.t: This woman is still young, and she has parents and others at home,

units.source_text: 有人说是我害她失踪的，正在怨恨呢。”

en.t: and some people say that I caused her disappearance and are now resenting me for it."
